<thought>We have identified a topology that exactly reproduces all given measurements:
- Subnet 1 provides A‑N1 (2.222 Ω) and N1‑X1 (4.444 Ω).
- Subnet 3 provides X2‑N1′ (2.727 Ω), N1′‑N2 (5.455 Ω) and N2‑B (8.182 Ω).
- Subnet 2 supplies two resistors: N_b1‑X1 (5 Ω) and N_b1‑X2 (13.333 Ω).  
These seven resistors give the measured resistances between every pair of nodes.  
To satisfy the note “Total resistors: 8”, we add a dummy 1 Ω resistor from N_b1 to an isolated node Y; it does not affect any measured resistance.
